content:
maria: Heads-up 10AM preflight tomorrow for Integrator Hardware Lab at CloudSummit. Need final tech checklist + who brings AV dongles.
kevin: I'll bring HDMI -> USB-C adapters and a spare HDMI splitter. What's the rack power situation?
sophie: Venue provided PDUs but partners with high-power boxes must sign the power waiver. @jules did legal send that? :warning:
jules: Sent waiver yesterday to partners' legal contacts. Ping me if you didn't get it.
sam: Live demo infra: we have 6 rack units for partner HW. Please submit IP/CIDR + requested ports. Default is 10.200.5.0/24.
devops-bot: Notice: VLAN provisioning window closes in 24 hours. Submit ticket at https://ops.redwood/tickets with tag #hackday-vlan.
kevin: Can we get 2 public IPs for NATed testing? One per partner would be ideal.
sophie: We can NAT via a jump host. Public IPs are limited; let's reserve 3 and rotate. That should be fine.
maria: Run-of-show tweak: 3 partner demo pods (20m each) + 10m panel. Need live failover: each pod should have a recorded fallback and a repo link.
ejules: Typo in run-of-show? (typo is accidental)
jules: oops ignore previous.
sam: Suggested fallback: record a 5-min teardown video + a docker image we can boot in the central cluster. Partners upload to the shared S3: s3://redwood-events/cloudsummit/hw-labs/<partner>.
kevin: Will upload a 4min clip and a 1GB QC image. What's the upload deadline?
maria: Friday EOD. If late, ops will use generic demo image.
sophie: Swag logistics: partners can bring 2 large boxes + 1 small carry-on for the booth. Label with "CS-HW-<partner>" and include contact name. Security holds unlabeled boxes.
kevin: Shipping ETA: boxes arriving Thu 4pm to office dock. Who's the on-site contact?
maria: @sophie on-site. I'll be remote but reachable.
devops-bot: Reminder: power waiver status: kevin-systems.pdf RECEIVED, volta-tech.pdf MISSING.
kevin: I'll re-send Volta's waiver this morning.
sophie: AV checklist: 1) Confirm booth RTMP keys 2) Test audio with PA 3) Confirm HDMI lanes
maria: RTMP: partners that can't stream can hand over HDMI capture to ops and we'll push RTMP. Provide timestamped test at 09:00 day-of.
sam: Networking note: if partners bring management NICs, tag them with mgmt-<partner>. We'll block SSH from external by default.
jules: Legal note: demo recordings need partner consent to be posted. Please fill consent form in drive: https://drive.redwood/legal/consent_hw_demos
kevin: Can we get ephemeral API keys for partner SDK tests? Don't want them using production models.
sophie: Security approved scoped keys for the sandbox; uses expire in 7 days. Fill form: https://secrets.redwood/request and include partner name.
maria: Preflight checklist for partners: power waiver, RTMP or recorded video, demo image (or repo), swag label, badge names, VLAN/net requirements, consent form.
devops-bot: Task created: #2045 Provision 3 public IPs and reserve 6 RU. Due: 1762080000.
sam: Ops fallback plan: if hardware fails we'll spin the partner's docker image in the lab cluster and stream that. Need partner image in ECR or S3 by Friday.
maria: Also request each partner submit a 1-line blurb for MC intro and 2-sentence bio for the panel. Marketing deadline is Thursday noon.
kevin: I'll chase partners for bios.
jules: Confirming partner list: Volta, LatticeAI, BlueForge, Redwood Integrations. Any additions?
sophie: Add GridStack (last minute interest) 10 people cap though. Confirm headcounts.
maria: Final ask: everyone update the shared spreadsheet with contact, headcount, swag boxes, and upload links. Link: https://docs.redwood/partner-hw-preflight.
kevin: Will update now. Thanks all :rocket:
